questions: What is logic?
If the logic contains a contradiction, can it still rule anything out?
What is an argument?
If one premise is false, does the argument fail?
What is a norm?
If everyone follows a norm, does that make it right?
What is form?
If the form changes, is it still the same thing?
What is a cause?
If the cause is gone, must the effect disappear too?
What is a canon?
If the canon is revised, do the old works stop counting?
What is deconstruction?
When deconstruction is finished, is there nothing left?
What is discourse?
If the discourse shifts, do the facts stay the same?
What is a theory?
If a theory does not predict anything, is it useless?
What is duty?
If duty gets in the way of what you want, can you ignore it?
What is value?
If everyone agrees on its value, does that make it valuable?
What is a property?
If a property is removed, is it still the same thing?
What is critique?
If a critique finds limits, must it reject what it examines?
What is a relation?
If a relation changes, must the things in it change too?
What is a state?
If the state changes, does the old one disappear?
